prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1320; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and has asked us to manage all communication regarding the claim. Please direct every inquiry, correspondence, and request for information to this firm and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client about this loss, please inform us so that we can address any statements that may have been made.

We request that you provide the full liability and bodily injury policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page, within fourteen days of receipt of this letter. We further ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle event data, witness statements, recorded calls, repair and salvage records, and any other materials in your or your insured's possession. Kindly confirm in writing that a preservation hold has been placed on these items.
